title: lex-v3/facts/1 relation fact
description: The closed tagged union of relation facts. A variant is identified by its explicit fact_kind and never by its shape: shape matching is exactly how a derived edge ends up read as a publisher assertion, because two variants that happen to share members are read as whichever the matcher tried first. Each variant restates none of its members; it composes the shared body and adds only its tag, so a member added to the graph cannot be added to one copy and forgotten in the other. oneOf rather than anyOf, so a document matching two variants is a failure rather than a coin toss.

fact_kind.description: The closed variant tag. An unrecognised value fails rather than defaulting to a known variant.
